artists.biography: Edward John O'Brien is an English guitarist, songwriter, and co-founder of the rock band Radiohead. O'Brien attended Abingdon School in Oxfordshire, England, where he formed Radiohead with schoolmates. He said his role was to "service the songs" and support the songwriter, Thom Yorke. He creates ambient sounds and textures using effects, sustain units and the EBow, and provides backing vocals.

perplexity.description:
Earth" is the debut solo album by Ed O'Brien, guitarist of Radiohead, released on April 17, 2020, through Capitol Records and Polydor. The album marks O'Brien's first release under the moniker EOB and showcases a blend of electronic and rock elements. Produced mainly by Flood, with contributions from Catherine Marks on one track, "Earth" features O'Brien on vocals, guitar, bass, keyboards, percussion, and programming, supported by a diverse group of musicians including Radiohead bandmate Colin Greenwood and artists like Adrian Utley and Glenn Kotche.

Musically, "Earth" explores atmospheric textures and rhythmic complexity, combining electronic soundscapes with organic instrumentation. This fusion creates a contemplative and expansive sound distinct from O'Brien's work within Radiohead, emphasizing his personal artistic voice. The album received positive critical attention for its ambitious production and emotional depth, establishing O'Brien as a solo artist capable of crafting immersive and nuanced music beyond his established role as a guitarist.
